무엇을: BNB 자동 소각(Auto-Burn) 2021-12-23 도입: 분기 소각을 바꿔 BNB 값과 그 분기 블록 수로 정하는 공식을 씀. Binance 거래소 매출과 무관. 총 공급의 절반(1억 BNB)이 남을 때까지. 직전 분기 소각은 1,335,888 BNB(약 6.39억 달러)
원문 근거 문장: BNB tokens will now be burned automatically based on a formula that includes blocks generated and BNB's price. ... the last quarterly burn, the company took 1,335,888 BNB, approximately $639,462,868 at the time / The algorithm does not take into account the revenues generated by the Binance exchange (ForkLog, S-REVBN-028)

원문 근거 문장: Teng emphasized that the company is financially robust despite the fine and remains profitable as it has always been since day one. " We have robust profits and revenue , so on that front , not to worry, we are in strong financial shape " ... Binance is debt-free and has modest expenses.

무엇을: Teng(CoinDesk 인터뷰, ForkLog 보도): 영업 다섯째 달부터 이익을 냈고 비용을 아껴 써서 상장(IPO)은 논의하지 않음
